From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Finova proofflow — redaction / escrow questions

Looping through a quick checklist before we commit: 

1) Redaction policy
- Pre-pull redaction (customer-side): safest for Finova but adds ops burden and increases coordination windows.
- Post-pull redaction (ProofLedger): faster onboarding, requires ProofLedger to certify redaction approach and retention policies.

2) Escrow ownership
- ProofLedger-managed escrow: simpler for Finova but we need SLA on retrieval and proof of custody.
- Customer-managed S3: Finova retains control, but increases friction for automated pulls.

3) Contract addendum
- If ProofLedger will store artifacts, legal wants a short addendum: data custody, retention schedule, breach notification timeline, and SLA for retrieval. I assume Ben can draft a template.

4) Pen-test coordination
- NorthPoint will need a list of in-scope endpoints, service account creds (time-limited), and confirmation of maintenance windows.

Please advise: do we require GlobalAudit to be looped in for SOC2 attestation before we hand over the matrix? That could slow to 2–3 weeks.

—Marcus
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@northpointsec.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Partnership Team <partnership@proofledger.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: NorthPoint availability & draft scope

Hi all — Alex Reed from NorthPoint Security. Thanks for the intro, Maya/Tessa.

NorthPoint can run the web-application + API penetration test the week of 6/21; we have a 3-day intensive window available (6/22–6/24) or a spread model (6/21–6/25, 2–3 hours/day) — whichever Finova prefers.

Attached is a one-page scope doc with the intake checklist. Key asks:
- Time-limited service account for test user (will be revoked on completion)
- A list of IPs to whitelist for our scanners (we can provide ranges)
- Point of contact for emergency findings (phone and slack)

We can work with ProofLedger for artifact access, but we generally prefer directed test accounts and explicit log pulls rather than third-party SFTP.
